summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd., a Singapore-based solar company under judicial management, announcing the resignations of several executives during an insolvency restructuring. Specifically, the former CHRO Tiffany See resigned effective June 19, 2026; interim Chief Legal Officer Frank Jeng resigned effective July 31, 2026; and CFO Dmitri Hu resigned effective August 14, 2026, also leaving subsidiary director roles. The company was placed under judicial management by Singapore's High Court as per the IRDA. The filing serves to update investors on the restructuring process. Key watchpoint: further executive departures may signal ongoing instability as judicial managers navigate the insolvency.
